Correction to the JSON above: the file is placed at the root so that it sits beside the approved RTL. Its path is `updown_counter.eqy` and it reads both RTL files by bare name.

=== FILE: updown_counter.eqy ===
[options]
splitnets on

[gold]
read_verilog updown_counter.v
prep -top updown_counter

[gate]
read_verilog updown_counter_refactor.v
prep -top updown_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 20
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===
